title: Integrated System of Opportunity Portfolios (SIPO)
contributions: Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, economists, geologists and geographers to design, develop and launch the platform. Focused on translating complex business and technical requirements into a usable application for executive-level analysis.
overview: SIPO is a web platform for strategic decision-making in the oil industry. It centralizes technical, economic, and geoscience data in one place, and combines interactive visualizations with Google Earth for real-time economic scenario analysis.
summary: Real-time decision-support system for the oil and gas industry
outcome: Web application that brought technical, economic, and geoscience data into one place for economic scenario analysis, with interactive charts and Google Earth. I worked on the software and the data side with engineers, economists, geologists, and geographers.

title: Representation of geographical data related to the Venezuelan Petroleum Industry
contributions: Worked closely with geologists and geographers to design and implement an automated process for creating and editing KML/KMZ files, so everyday visualization did not depend on opening specialized GIS tools.
overview: The project simplified access to large volumes of geographical and hydrocarbon data, such as oil fields, geological formations, and infrastructure, that were usually locked in specialized software such as ArcGIS. It automated the creation and management of KML and KMZ files so wider teams could work with that information.
summary: Wider access to complex geospatial and hydrocarbon data
outcome: Automated creation and editing of KML/KMZ so geological and infrastructure data could be viewed in Google Earth without opening ArcGIS for every visualization.

title: Augmented Intelligence for Data Visualization Analytics
contributions: Collaborated with the engineering team to design and build an AR/MR application for visualizing sales trends and a chatbot interface that allowed users to query and explore data through natural interaction, integrated with the Qlik Sense ecosystem.
overview: The project combined augmented and mixed reality with a virtual assistant, so people without a technical background could explore large datasets and sales trends in a more intuitive way, inside the Qlik Sense ecosystem.
summary: Complex data, easier to explore through augmented reality and conversation
outcome: I contributed to the UI and front end of an augmented-reality and chatbot demo for exploring sales data in Qlik Sense.
